request: Diluc should be closer to the previous generation. Aether needs a more interesting pose. Previous direction for Diluc: arms at his sides.
method: built-in image_gen, one asset per call

references.role: official portrait: identity, costume and illustration style
user-provided in-game model: face, identity and costume

tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait, guiding identity, costume and polished anime illustration style; image 2 is the user-provided in-game model, guiding face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Faithfully preserve these details, translating the model into the illustrated style of the official portrait. Petite Medium Male proportions. Friendly, adventurous neutral pose: stand in a relaxed three-quarter angle with a gentle weight shift, his right hand resting loosely over his belt and his left hand raised near his chest in a small open conversational gesture. Look attentively toward the viewer. Follow the in-game model closely for the face: matching golden amber irises each with one small dark pupil inside, clear upper and lower eyelids and a natural shared gaze, with one distinct eye on each side of the face. Hair and clothing hang naturally. Each hand has a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb with natural articulation, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. One coherent mouth and neutral expression. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes visible with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
